perCase.reasoning: The department did not explain why your pension stopped or when it will be paid. It only said the case was forwarded and then closed here. It gave no recipient or reference you can use to follow up.

The department explains the rejection reason and what to do next. It also gives a clear processing timeframe after resubmission. This answers the citizen’s question fully.

The department explains the higher bill by stating last month’s reading was estimated and this month’s was actual, causing an adjustment. It quantifies the adjustment (Rs. 1,240). It also tells where to see the breakdown (page 2).
The department explains the cause of delay and gives the audit clearance date. It also states the exact payment date and amount. This answers when the arrears were paid.

The department explains the delay was due to pending police verification and gives the completion date. It also confirms printing and dispatch with a tracking number. This answers why it stalled and what happened next.

The department did not give the rejection reason. It names the receiving office and provides a transfer reference, and closes the case here. This is a lawful transfer with actionable details.
